name: Din Tai Fung - Tampines Mall
description: Din Tai Fung is a world-renowned restaurant specializing in Taiwanese cuisine particularly its famous xiao long bao (soup dumplings). Known for its meticulous preparation and exceptional flavors it’s a must-visit for dumpling enthusiasts.

items.description: Savour the exquisite taste of Din Tai Fung’s Pineapple Cakes — handmade with natural Taiwanese pineapples and no preservatives. Each bite delivers a buttery crumble and a perfect sweet-tangy finish.

At 40% larger than our signature Xiao Long Bao, each dumpling is filled with succulent crab meat, juicy pork and rich chilli crab broth for a truly local flavour experience.
